sloka: बहुपुत्रो दरिद्रश्च ज्वररोगसमन्वितः ।स भूयात्सततक्लेशी यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४९॥
transliteration: bahuputro daridraśca jvararogasamanvitaḥ ।sa bhūyātsatatakleśī yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-49॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be always miserable with many sons, poverty and fever and disease
